title: EarthScience FieldLoggerSegmentDrift

stats.done_summary: Completed TWDM soil-logger segment drift QA. Implemented TWDM per spec (epsilon-stabilized, third-window mean range over population std), validated against manifest golden cases (max abs error reported and enforced ≤1e-9), generated ordered per-segment table (outputs/segment_twdm_table.csv and in report), and saved a VWC vs frame figure for an example segment under report/images/. Final write-up in report/report.md.
